name: Bad Teacher (KD with incompetent teacher)
tagline: Per-sample KD: distill from a frozen competent teacher on retain samples and from a randomly re-initialised incompetent teacher on forget samples.

nodes.label: On step 0: capture competent + reinit incompetent

diff_from_baseline: Chundawat, Tarun, Mandal & Kankanhalli, AAAI 2023 — Can Bad Teaching Induce Forgetting? Standard dual-teacher KD baseline (incompetent vs. competent) for class-wise unlearning.

name: Negative Gradient
tagline: Descend cross-entropy on retain data while ascending it on forget data via a small negative-weight subtraction.
diff_from_baseline: Golatkar et al., CVPR 2020 (Forgetting Outside the Box) and follow-ups — gradient-ascent unlearning. Subtracts a fraction of the forget-set gradient from the retain-set update; simplest non-trivial unlearning baseline.

name: Retain fine-tune
tagline: Plain SGD/Adam fine-tuning on the retain set only — vanilla catastrophic-forgetting baseline.
diff_from_baseline: Common reference baseline in MUFAC / NeurIPS 2023 unlearning benchmarks. Continued training on retained data only — no explicit forgetting signal — relies on catastrophic forgetting of the held-out class.

name: SCRUB
tagline: Min-max KD against a frozen original teacher: maximise KL on the forget set for the first msteps epochs, always minimise CE + α·KL on retain.
formula: $$\begin{aligned}\text{Max (epoch} < m_{\text{steps}}\text{):} \;& -\mathrm{KL}_T\!\big(\mathrm{softmax}(z_s^{f}/T) \,\|\, \mathrm{softmax}(z_t^{f}/T)\big) \cdot T^2 \\ \text{Min (every epoch):} \;& \gamma\,\mathrm{CE}(z_s^{r}, y_r) + \alpha\,\mathrm{KL}_T\!\big(z_s^{r} \,\|\, z_t^{r}\big)\cdot T^2 \end{aligned}$$
diff_from_baseline: Kurmanji, Triantafillou, Hayes & Triantafillou, NeurIPS 2023 — Towards Unbounded Machine Unlearning (SCRUB). Min-max distillation against the frozen original; defaults follow the authors' VGG notebook.
